go_reasons: Default-off behavior is equivalent on the protected Stage 5 sample.
Enabled protected-control smoke produced no paired metric delta or shadow regression.
Selector evidence is visible and bounded to already materialized suggestions.
Rollback tag exists before runtime-test commits.
no_go_reasons: The selector did not select or suppress the actual chosen move in protected or Stage 7 smoke.
Stage 7 challenge conversion did not improve.
Scaling larger validation now would mostly measure a no-op selector path.
Raising penalties would not help when penalized suggestions are not selected.

recommendation.primary: Do not scale, promote, or tune this two-stage abstention selector now.
recommendation.secondary: Keep the default-off implementation as a reversible runtime-test scaffold because it passed default-off and protected smoke checks.
